svg.text: Fundamental equity research (DCF, trading multiples, sensitivity analysis) for a student-managed fund, and in-house Python tools for
portfolio optimisation, probabilistic valuation and AI forecasting.
Automated bank reconciliations and FX allowance requests in Python, saving ~4 h a week (scripts still used by the team). Built a
complete VAT refund claim for a major French entity, end to end.
Built an AI integration layer (MCP) on Apache Superset for management reporting, and an AI system that parses SEC filings into
structured Excel inputs for valuation models.
LCH SA · London Stock Exchange Group
Contributed to an Initial Margin model for cleared digital-asset derivatives, working across Risk and IT Security. Treasury collateral
